Identified as this saint because: Commons' description names her in full as 'Акилина Библосская' — Aquilina of Byblos — on a 19th-century Russian icon shared with Paraskeva; it is in Category:Icons of St. Aquilina. The byname Byblos distinguishes her from the other martyrs called Aquilina. Commons describes it: Икона Святая Акилина Библосская и Святая Параскева Пятница. Россия 19 век.
